_notes._lang: Japanese pages (<html lang="ja">, kana in the text). Through 1.4.x any page with enough Han characters made the site zh-CN.
_notes.g.ssr: Kana counts as characters. Through 1.4.x only Han was counted, every page read as 47–79 characters, and this gate scored 0 (the site was capped at 40).
_notes.p2.answer-passages: Read in characters, kana included. Through 1.4.x the passages counted only their Han characters and this scored 0.
_notes.p2.question-intent: No question-intent lexicon for Japanese, so the check is not observed. Through 1.4.x the headings were read with the English and Chinese lexicon.
_notes.p2.sourced-stats: The figures carry no link, <cite> or footnote, and a source named in Japanese words cannot be read: not observed, never zero.
_notes.p2.named-author: No author in structured data or rel=author, and a written byline in Japanese cannot be read: not observed, never zero.
_notes.p3.knowledge-graph: The lookups go to Japanese and English; offsite.json answers ja.wikipedia for this brand. Through 1.4.x they went to Chinese and English and found nothing.
_notes.p4.cn-engines: A Japanese site is not a Chinese-language site. Through 1.4.x its Han text made this check observable.
